title: 30A 4BR/3.5BA Vacation Home with two Community Pools
meta_description: Grayt Comfort, a 4BR, 3.5BA vacation home on 30A in a quiet gated community close to the beach, with tennis courts and two community pools. Sleeps 14.
description_expanded: You couldn't ask for a better beach retreat. A quiet gated community with tennis and 2 community pools ... and a beach home that has plenty of space for a large family or multiple families. Grayt Comfort is located in the Preserve at Grayton Beach and has 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms and 2 half baths.When you walk in you're greeted by a cozy little sitting area, not to mention the expansive front porch. Also on the 1st floor are 3 of the bedrooms. Bedroom 1 and 2 share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with dual vessel sinks and modern tile accents. There is an additional bedroom on the 1st floor that includes a private attached bathroom.Take the stairs up to the 2nd floor to find the main living area that opens to the beautiful chef's kitchen. Dine at the large table or pull up a stool to the kitchen counter. Enjoy even more outdoor living space with a large balcony and more seating. There is a convenient half bath right off the kitchen. Also on the 2nd floor is the master retreat with king bed and private bath. The bathroom is a true spa experience with dual sinks, soaker tub and separate glass-enclosed shower.Up on the 3rd floor is an additional bonus space with balcony access. Enjoy soaring views of the tree-lined area. A great spot for everyone to gather together and dine al-fresco!Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Full bed, TV and Jack-and-Jill bathroom shared with Bedroom 21st Floor, Bedroom 2: 2 sets of full-over-full bunks and shared bathroom with Bedroom 11st Floor, Bedroom 3: Queen bed, desk, TV and private bathroom and private patio access2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV, private balcony, and private bathroomBeach Access:Exit the neighborhood and cross 30A. To the west of Sanctuary by The Sea complex you'll find your gated walkway to the beach. Once down the pathway, head right towards the public beach or on your left past the sections of private beach you'll find Grayton Beach State Park.Preserve at Grayton Beach:The Preserve at Grayton Beach is an ultra-exclusive and gated community right on Scenic 30A. This neighborhood features custom built beach-chic homes with state-of-the-art amenities and inclusions. In one of these meticulously appointed homes, you’ll find yourself surrounded by one-of-a-kind beauty that is unsurpassed in every sense. Enjoy 2 community pools (1 heated seasonally) and tennis courts. The location puts you within walking or biking distance from all the area's popular spots. From ice cream to shopping, you'll find it in the Grayton Beach and Blue Mountain Beach areas.Your stay at Grayt Comfort comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars(on driveway) and 1 spot in front of house* Sorry, no pets allowed.* No golf carts or trailers allowed in the Preserve at GraytonAn initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
